[[Ducha]] '''Luvalle''' was a [[Hapan]] [[Noble/Legends|noblewoman]] who served in the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|emergence]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. In [[44 ABY]], Luvalle acted as one of the leaders of a Hapan detachment that assisted with the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].
